facts.description: Executable command state reaches CharacterMainCtrlSystem.OnExecutePlayerCommand; preserved command enum is forwarded to ComboController.RefreshNextSkillRequest on owner AbilitySystem.
Execute returns void and does not test the callee return register. OnExecute uses Refresh result for selected raw command fallback branches, not as universal cast acceptance.

Center _ToSkill requires stored request allow and a positive SkillType, then gets input, checks interrupt admission and CanCastSkill. Success stores copied input in state payload; it does not call TryCastSkill.

_TickToCastSkill selects eligible entity request, obtains next skill and input, calls interrupt and CanCastSkill, then CastComboSkill(entity,inputView). CastComboSkill rechecks CanCastSkill(inputView), updates pending entry and calls a physical target with integer argument5; it returns void. The physical target declaration and later execution are separate joins.
